hints.text: A fraction bar is just another way to write a division sign.
The number being shared goes on top; the number of shares goes on the bottom.

explanation: A fraction means "top divided by bottom," so any division can be written as a fraction.
Here $3$ is being split into $4$ equal parts, so $3$ is the numerator and $4$ is the denominator.

alternativeExplanations.title: Picture it
steps: Imagine $3$ granola bars shared by $4$ friends.
Cut each bar into $4$ pieces — that is $12$ pieces, and each friend takes $3$ of them.
$3$ pieces out of the $4$ that make one bar is $\frac{3}{4}$ of a bar ✓
